newsitem.title: USA: Biocircuits sees Q1 shr loss $0.41.
newsitem.headline: Biocircuits sees Q1 shr loss $0.41.

text.p: Biocircuits Corp on Wednesday said it expects a first quarter net loss of $3.5 million, or $0.41 a share, versus a loss of $3.9 million, or $0.99 a share, one year ago.
The company said its product sales to distributors in the first quarter should total $234,000.
In addition, the company said it cut its overall workstaff to 54 employees from 92 company-wide, except in its sales group where four positions were added.
"Adding people to the sales force to train and assist distributor sales people is a key element to increasing results," John Kaiser, chief executive, said in a statement.

The staff cuts have reduced expenses but should not materially effect sales in the near term. Still, some longer-term projects affecting product development and cartridge cost reduction will be necessarily delayed, Kaiser said.

Finally, the company said it completed a private placement of stock totaling $8.0 million. Of that sum, the company received gross proceeds of $1.7 million on April 15. It will receive gross proceeds $5.5 million at the end of the second quarter and $800,000 at year end 1997 depending on the completion of certain milestones.
